source_name: City of Phoenix - City Parcels (phoenixopendata.com / egishub-phoenix)
licence: Portal CKAN record tags CC-BY, but dataset notes say non-commercial; service says viewing/label only
licence_quote: Service description: "To be used for viewing/label purposes only." (CKAN notes also state non-commercial use only, contradicting license_id cc-by.)

tested.note: Test = ArcGIS REST query returnCountOnly=true, envelope ~200 m around block centre (EPSG:4326), run 2026-11-25.

notes: Conflicting licence signals (cc-by tag vs non-commercial note vs 'viewing/label only'); also 'does not include ALL City Parcels but only unique address records'. Maricopa Assessor is RED (A.R.S. 39-121.03). No green parcel source found for Phoenix. AZ state (AZGeo) not checked - web search budget exhausted.

source_name: City of Scottsdale GIS data sales (parcels shapefile)
licence: Paid data sale; redistribution needs written permission
licence_quote: "cannot be redistributed (sales, copies, etc.) in any form without written permission from the City of Scottsdale." / "Commercial uses of the data are subject to higher fees."

tested.note: No public parcel REST layer with a licence found; not tested.

notes: Scottsdale AR297 open-data policy defines its open licence for non-commercial use only. Maricopa Assessor RED. Phoenix CityParcels does not cover Scottsdale. No green path found.

source_name: City of Las Vegas ArcGIS - CC_PARCELS_SHP (Clark County Assessor parcels)
licence: Item licenceInfo is a disclaimer only; underlying Clark County Assessor/GISMO parcel data is sold under a subscriber licence agreement
licence_quote: Item: "The City of Las Vegas makes no warranty, representation or guarantee of any kind regarding either any maps or other information provided herein..." (no grant). County: annual subscription requires a licence agreement and fee.

tested.note: Test = ArcGIS REST query returnCountOnly=true, envelope ~200 m around block centre (EPSG:4326), run 2026-11-25. Layer also contains OWNER/ADDRESS1-5 mailing fields - never request them (use an outFields whitelist).

notes: City 2016 open-data policy says portal datasets are public domain, but this layer is Clark County Assessor data (paid subscriber agreement) - treat as red unless the City portal item itself carries a PD licence.
